lines.en: Drop off my dry cleaning, pick up my vitamins,
teach me how to spell vitamins,
wear in my new jeans.
You realize what you are, don't you?
What?
You're his bitch.
No, no, no!
Wait, you didn't just sit on my Kit Kats, did you?
No, there was a little dip in the market
and I lost $13 million.
But the Kit Kats are all right.
What am I going to do? What am I going to do?
I can't call my office, they'll kill me.
I can't call my clients, they'll kill themselves.
Great, now my chest hurts.
What?
My chest hurts.
Ugh, and now I can't breathe.
Phoebe, are you having a heart attack?
Well, if I were, would I have shooting pains
up and down my left arm?
Yes.
Then yes, that is what I'm having.
Oh, my God!
I'll see you next time.
